answer: Sybil resistance relies on each agent identity being registered against a remotely verified enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), with fresh attestation and platform-bound credentials preventing a copied VM from impersonating another enrolled enclave. The measurement proves which code is running; hardware-backed credentials make enrollment costly to multiply, typically requiring additional physical silicon. Names such as sparrow, quartz, and violet gain no extra identities merely by being duplicated in software.
